title: Jaguar (Pvt) Ltd. — Apparel Manufacturer
content: Jaguar (Pvt) Ltd. is a vertically integrated apparel manufacturer supporting global brands with wovens, knits, and baby wear programs. The company emphasizes audited compliance, scalable production, and long-term manufacturing partnerships.

title: Wovens
content: We produce structured shirting, bottoms, and uniform programs with integrated cutting, sewing, and finishing. Monthly capacity is program-dependent. Certifications such as GOTS, OEKO-TEX, and WRAP may apply depending on facility and program scope.

title: Knits
content: We support jersey, fleece, and performance knit programs with capacity for large programs and certified organic options. GOTS and OEKO-TEX may apply at selected facilities.

title: Baby Wear
content: Baby wear programs focus on soft-hand construction, secure attachments, and compliance-focused finishing. A Baby Wear catalogue is available on the Baby Wear page.

title: Governance & Certifications
content: Published certifications include GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, WRAP, and ISO 14001 at selected facilities. Certification scope varies by facility and product line.

title: Environment
content: Environmental programs include water stewardship, renewable energy installations, and waste reduction tracked against published benchmarks.

title: Manufacturing Facilities
content: Published facilities include the Faisalabad Manufacturing City Unit (wovens and knits, cut-and-sew and finishing) and the Faisalabad Dyeing Unit (knits dyeing). The Facility page includes an interactive map, facility cards, and a Process & Capabilities section covering 15 production departments from yarn warehouse through packing and audits.

title: Process & Capabilities
content: Process & Capabilities covers fifteen departments grouped into raw material and testing, fabric production, embellishment, cut/sew/wet processing, and finishing/QA—including yarn warehouse, dyeing lab, knitting, dyeing, screen printing, embroidery, cutting, stitching, garment dyeing, washing, finishing, QC, metal detection, audits, and packing.

title: Careers
content: Careers at Jaguar span manufacturing operations, quality and compliance, product development, sustainability, and commercial/corporate functions. Open roles link to the external ATS from the Careers page.

title: Contact & RFQ
content: Qualified RFIs and RFQs can be submitted through the Contact page. The team responds within 2 business days with clear next steps. The assistant cannot provide pricing or real-time capacity guarantees.
